access_boundary: This record represents the InternLM3-8B-Instruct checkpoint of the InternLM line. The base model, the InternLM2 and 2.5 generations, the newer Intern-S and Atria releases, and the LMDeploy serving toolkit are separate boundaries.
strengths: Apache 2.0 grant stated in the model card and carried in a LICENSE.txt file inside the weight repository
Deep-thinking and normal response modes with tool support in an 8B checkpoint that runs on a single accelerator
tradeoffs: No developer API or managed host serves this checkpoint, so running it is entirely self-operated
The card's limitations section warns the model may produce biased or harmful content and disclaims responsibility for its dissemination
